collection.description: An elderly scientist with hundreds of uncertain sketches fears dying before the catalogue is done.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An elderly scientist has hundreds of sketches with uncertain names and fears dying before completing the catalogue.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The records become a multigenerational project.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Other scholars can correct mistakes without erasing the elder's work.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The elder completes a careful record and finds peace with what remains unknown.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The collection survives only if family members later discover it.
